statement.note_ascii: At fixed target k the equal-shell triad family is one-parameter (theta). statement.latest: \text{W3 real field, 12 modes }\pm p_i,\pm q_i,\ \hat u(k)=0.\ \text{One full-convolution generation (all 60 pairs with }m_1+m_2\ne0\text{) lands on 44 distinct targets: }\pm k\ (\text{exactly cancelled}),\ 6\text{ at }|t|^2=\tfrac94\ (F_t\equiv0),\ \text{and }36\text{ with }F_t\ne0:\ 6\text{ at }|t|^2=\tfrac34\ (2\text{ sources, }C_t=\tfrac{\sqrt{39}}4-\tfrac{\sqrt3}2>0),\ 12\text{ at }\tfrac74,\ 6\text{ at }3,\ 12\text{ at }\tfrac{13}4\ (\text{single source each}).\ \text{No rescaling }a_i\to\lambda_ia_i,\ b_i\to\mu_ib_i\ \text{with }\lambda_i\mu_i=s\text{ kills all off-}k\text{ forcings except }s=0.
statement.note_ascii: The parents' own cross-interactions (p_i,p_j), (q_i,q_j), (p_i,-p_j), (p_i,-p_i) produce forced descendants that cannot cancel (single source) -- forced novelty in the sense of Section 111.7 / 118.1. The (p_i,p_j) and (q_i,q_j) forcings scale as lambda_i lambda_j and mu_i mu_j, so they are independent of how the parents are balanced into k. Six targets at |t|^2=9/4 are structural zeros of B for that geometry (not designed in).

honest_caveats: One seed, one generation, exact. It shows THIS cancellation witness is not a zero-defect web at depth 1 (novelty branch), consistent with the source's Section 16 conjecture on one instance. It is not a proof of that conjecture and not a statement about any other seed.
